p1_b0.ocr: As the maritime industry navigates an evolving economic landscape, understanding the current vessel age profile, alongside scrapping and newbuild order book status, has never been more critical.

p1_b2.ocr: The data presented in the accompanying table sheds light on the composition of the fleet, particularly the distribution of vessels across various AgeGroup categories, which is essential for assessing the overall health and sustainability of shipping operations.

p1_b3.ocr: Notably, the Count and Percentage columns provide insight into the prevalence of aging vessels, which may face increased operational costs and regulatory challenges.
